text:
jordan (Release Manager): kicking off phasewise geofence commit. plan: US -> EU -> APAC. pinned version: v2.3.1. change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. need SRE + oncall ✅ from each region before we open canary traffic.
liam (SRE): checking GPU pools now, will post numbers in a min. asking infra to hold warm-pool for EU.
sana (Oncall): i'm on standby for the window. give me rollback criteria and expected signals to watch.
sam (Eng): adding quick smoke test set to release notes. primary criteria: error rate < 0.5% and p95 latency <= 220ms for text-gen route. if either breaches for 3 consecutive minutes -> rollback.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job created: job_id=rb-2026-2788880123. pinned image: redwood/inference:v2.3.1. phases: us-canary(5%), us-full, eu-canary(3%), eu-full, apac-canary(3%), apac-full.
jordan (Release Manager): @liam can you confirm capacity numbers (GPU free, warm-pool, kvcache hit ratio) for each region? we need headroom for +25% burst. also confirm KMS health for private deployments.
liam (SRE): quick summary: US free gpus=18, warm_pool=6 nodes (reserve set), kvcache hit ~72%. EU free gpus=7, warm_pool=2 nodes (i asked infra for +1), kvcache hit ~68%. APAC free gpus=4, warm_pool=1 node (low), kvcache hit ~65%. KMS OK across regions, latency normal.
maya (PM): EU looks marginal. propose holding EU full until we validate canary for 30m and ensure warm_pool scaleup triggers. set eu-canary holdpoint at +30m in the job.
jordan (Release Manager): agree. updating rollout plan: insert holdpoint after eu-canary for 30m. deploy-bot, apply holdpoint.
deploy-bot: holdpoint inserted: eu-canary -> pause 30m -> continue. note: automated fallback set to v2.2.8 if rollback triggered.
sam (Eng): smoke test snippets below — run after each canary cut:
```
# health checks
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"health-check"}' | jq '.status'
redwoodctl check capacity --region eu --min-warm=3
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=redwood-serving -o wide
```
liam (SRE): running quick dry-run of smoke tests on US canary cluster now. will paste results.
ops-bot: deploy event: rb-2026-2788880123 started by jordan. canary US at 5% launching.
liam (SRE): US canary pods healthy: 10/10 ready. p95 latency sample: 190ms. error rate: 0.12%. kvcache hit climbed to 75% after prefix caching. US looks green.
jordan (Release Manager): proceeding to US full in 10m if no regressions. anyone object?
sana (Oncall): no objections. monitoring dashboards & alerting set. I added runbook link: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/rollbacks
ops-bot: US full rollout initiated.
liam (SRE): US full completed. capacity spare left ~12 GPUs.
maya (PM): updating release notes: "v2.3.1: production inference optimizations, KV cache improvements, canary gating for EU due to warm-pool sizing." will publish once EU canary passes.
jordan (Release Manager): starting EU canary now (3%). remember holdpoint after 30m.
liam (SRE): EU canary pods 3/3 ready. initial p95 210ms, error 0.4%. warming warm_pool +1 requested, scaling appears to be kicking in.
sam (Eng): running smoke tests against EU canary: health ok, trace sampling looks normal.
sana (Oncall): watching alerts. set temporary soft-threshold to avoid noisy paging while we validate.
liam (SRE): after 18m, EU p95 rose to 260ms for a short spike correlated with background compaction job on storage. we throttled compaction; p95 back to 205ms. no error spike.
jordan (Release Manager): that's an acceptable transient. continue to holdpoint for remaining 12m. if it stays stable, proceed to EU full.
ops-bot: holdpoint timer expired. awaiting manual resume from jordan.
jordan (Release Manager): resuming EU full now.
ops-bot: EU full rollout started.
liam (SRE): EU full completed. final free gpus=3, warm_pool=3. headroom now ~+15%, within our +25% target? it's tight but acceptable for now.
maya (PM): triggering APAC canary but lowering canary to 2% due to lower headroom. APAC holdpoint 20m before full.
sam (Eng): note for oncall: rollback playbook if apac p95 >300ms for >3min or error rate >1%.
sana (Oncall): acknowledged. I'll be ready to flip the fallback to v2.2.8 if needed.
ops-bot: APAC canary rollout at 2% started.
liam (SRE): APAC canary pods 2/2 ready. initial p95 230ms, error 0.6%. monitoring.
jordan (Release Manager): looks okay so far. holdpoint running.
liam (SRE): at +12m APAC saw two transient 1m spikes at 320ms due to noisy neighbor on host. we cordoned the host, the service recovered. no user-facing errors.
jordan (Release Manager): given recovery and no errors, proceed to APAC full.
ops-bot: APAC full rollout initiated.
liam (SRE): APAC full completed. overall rollout done. final metrics: global p95 205ms, global error 0.18%, kvcache avg 71%.
jordan (Release Manager): great work team. publishing release notes and linking release artifacts. tagging all involved for postmortem comments within 24h if any lingering issues. :tada: 
maya (PM): will publish short post-deploy note to customers about improved latency and canary gating.
sana (Oncall): i'll keep monitoring overnight. set an oncall reminder in 2h.
sam (Eng): leaving a command log in the job artifacts. job_id=rb-2026-2788880123.
deploy-bot: rollout complete. artifacts: s3://redwood-releases/rb-2026-2788880123/artifacts.zip. fallback image: redwood/inference:v2.2.8.
jordan (Release Manager): closing thread. good job everyone?
